sampling: 12 ideal playback targets, four per timeline third, longest side at most 480. FFmpeg fixture decode, packaged WASM model and production temporal feature extraction.
policy: Baseline: original eligibility and lower-quartile score >= 0.65. Candidate retains the baseline and adds a sustained-evidence route. Only the mixed-frame reason may be present, motion energy >= 0.01, lower-quartile score >= 0.10, and at least two passing frames and a strict majority scoring >= 0.10 in every timeline third.
scope: Fresh evaluation uses one source per generator and unique genuine authors and URLs, disjoint from the development videos. These short, public clips do not validate long videos, live streams or deployed false-positive rates. Wilson 95% intervals are approximate. Both MDN encodings count as one genuine source.
